Irene / Monica —

Quick capacity and technical notes (summary):
- Baseline: current reranker path averages 6k qps during peak tests; with production reranker expect 12–18k qps depending on sampling. Use 20k qps committed for headroom.
- Model mix: add a 16k-context decoder-only model for summaries (longer KV cache lifetime). This increases memory pressure: estimate ~1.6x KV cache compared to 8k profiles.
- GPU sizing: For 20k qps with p95 targets ~120ms we recommend:
  • H100-only option: 16x H100 (reserved) — best latency and headroom
  • Hybrid option: 10x H100 + 12x A100 — 10–15% higher p95 but ~22% lower monthly commit cost
- Autoscaling: configure a dedicated reserved pool with a 1.5x burst buffer (pre-warmed nodes) and a cold-spare policy for region fallback.
- Fallback policy suggestion: route to a quantized 8-bit 8k-context variant with a grace degradation policy (informational header in API response).

I attached a quick perf table and a conservative cost delta estimate.

-Karthik
Principal Infra Engineer — Redwood Inference

Subject: Proposed amendment & pricing tiers (Nimble Retail renewal)

Sam / team —

Thanks for the call earlier. Per our discussion we are attaching a proposed amendment (v2) that includes:
- 24-month committed term starting 2027-04-01
- Reserved pool options: Option A (H100-only, 16 GPUs), Option B (Hybrid, 10 H100 + 12 A100)
- Throughput tiers (committed qps): 10k / 15k / 20k with defined burst allowance (1.5x) and per-route guarantees
- Fallback & roll-forward policy: automatic fallback to quantized 8k model + notification header; auto-fallback to warm spare region if cross-region capacity shortfall
- SLAs: p95 latency target commitments and associated service credits for missed monthly SLOs
- Pricing: line items for monthly reserved cost and surcharge for burst consumption beyond allowance

Please review the attached PDF and send any redlines to procurement@redwoodinference.com. If procurement is ready, we can prepare a DocuSign envelope and incorporate final redlines.

Best,
Monica Patel
